# Sanskrit Karaoke — v1.5.6

> Sing-along practice app for Sanskrit texts: catalogue of tracks, teacher mode, and an installable manifest (PWA).

## Pages

- [Karaoke home](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritKaraoke/): track selection and player.
- [Catalogue](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritKaraoke/catalogue.html): full track catalogue.
- [Web-app manifest](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritKaraoke/manifest.json): PWA manifest.

Source: https://github.com/gasyoun/SanskritKaraoke
